title: Release history entry
description: One vendor release captured for a tool's changelog view. A version/date claim has no legitimate uncited form: evidence is unconditionally required, unlike additional-fact.schema.json and use-case.schema.json's documented/inferred split.

product_version.description: Optional discrete product/build version number officially associated with this release (e.g. '1.73', 'v0.22'), distinct from `version`'s human-readable release title. Omit entirely if the vendor does not publish a discrete version number for this release.
